definitions.gloss: with a self-satisfied grin; with a smug or pleased smile
definitions.explanation: Describes the expression or manner of someone smiling to themselves out of self-satisfaction, smug pleasure, or quiet delight — often when something went their way or they have a secret advantage.

examples.japanese: にんまり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}って→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧、にんまり⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He smiled smugly after winning the match.

examples.japanese: ⟦{値引|ねび}き→値引き：05424_nebiki⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらえた→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、にんまりし⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I left the shop with a satisfied grin after getting a discount.

notes:
An onomatopoeic/mimetic adverb describing a self-satisfied smile. Has a slightly smug or scheming quality that makes it distinct from simply smiling happily. Often used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ or ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- にんまり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to grin with satisfaction
- にんまり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧: to smile smugly
- にんまり⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧: a self-satisfied expression

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦にっこり→にっこり：03517_nikkori⟧: smiling brightly — warm and open, not self-satisfied
- ニヤリ: grinning slyly — more sinister or mischievous
- ⟦にやにや→にやにや：05766_niyaniya⟧: smirking — sustained, often unsettling grin
